reconstruction_procedure: From the official MIP 2018 tables, obtain the symmetric product-by-product class-level domestic, imported, and combined-origin workbooks. Archived file identifiers are MIP_19, MIP_38, MIP_10.
From the official COU 2018 tables, obtain basic-price use at branch level for domestic, imported and combined origin. Archived file identifiers are COU_177, COU_184, COU_170.
Match table titles and source vintage metadata before re-extraction. Verify the SHA256 hashes listed here if reproducing the exact archived snapshot. A newer revision may differ.

Place workbooks in a source directory under the recorded basenames. Run python extract_cells.py SOURCE_DIRECTORY then python analyze.py. The latter uses only the included snapshot and works fully offline.
excluded_scope: Bilateral origins, named cheese allocation, retail channels, Leontief multipliers, price pass-through and policy counterfactuals are not estimated.
